- **Output:** `/home/mara/cwe-bench/sibling2/out/screener/36508.json`. I re-checked every file:line it cites against the pinned code.
- **Trust decision:** `UrlSanitizer::parse()` (`src/Symfony/Component/HtmlSanitizer/TextSanitizer/UrlSanitizer.php:101-142`) decides whether a URL from an untrusted HTML attribute is safe to write back out. Its deny check caught raw BiDi marks and ASCII whitespace only, so percent-encoded BiDi marks and raw or encoded Unicode whitespace got through.
- **`pattern_fit`: B.** The published fix touches one file and one internal helper, so there is no Pattern A scope.
- **Strongest lever:** `srcset`, `imagesrcset`, `longdesc`, `manifest` and `usemap` are on the safe-attribute list (`W3CReference.php:305`, `:373`), but the URL attribute sanitizer never checks them. `srcset` is a list of URLs where whitespace is legitimate, which gives a solver an easy reason to leave it out. Fixing it properly needs a real list parser, not just one more search hit.
- **Biggest red flag:** none of the formal red flags apply. The weak spots: the uncovered routes are attributes the URL check never covered at all, which may read as a separate bug; the fix is small (about 25 minutes); and I couldn't check whether the latest release still has these routes open (no latest tree was provided).
